secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL the app reads and signs users in against.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key used by the browser client (protected by row level security).

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key (Resend dashboard -> API Keys, Sending access). Used server-side to send signup verification and account emails from noreply@myspaza-app.co.za.

secrets.name: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret of the Resend webhook that points at /api/webhooks/resend (Resend dashboard -> Webhooks -> signing secret, whsec_...). Verifies delivery events before they are stored.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret generated when the Supabase Send Email auth hook is enabled (Auth -> Hooks, format v1,whsec_...). Verifies Supabase's hook requests to /api/hooks/supabase/send-email.
